    Vince Giordano and the Nighthawks

    5:30 PM · Birdland Theater, Hell's Kitchen · $24.91 · ↻ Also on other days Algo especial

    In his Birdland Theater residency, GRAMMY® Award winner, New York native, and multi-instrumentalist Vince Giordano leads The Nighthawks -- an 11-piece band who have set the standard for recreating authentic jazz sounds of the 1920s and beyond. In addition to club and concert appearances around the world, the band has provided period soundtracks for film and television productions including The Cotton Club, The Aviator, Finding Forrester, Revolutionary Road, Cafe Society, HBOs Boardwalk Empire, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, the upcoming Martin Scorsese film Killers of The Flower Moon, and many more.

    The Cabaret Burlesque presents: Code Red

    9:00 PM · Berlin, East Village · $42.71 · ↻ Every Monday Para salir

    TCB presents: CODE RED Industry Night Weekly on Monday Doors 8pm Guest Opening Acts 8pm Main Show featuring The Cabaret Burlesque 9-10:30 Music and Bar until 12 am Contact @thecabaretburlesque on instagram to APPLY to perform as an Opening Act An Industry Night where your wildest fantasies just might come true. Welcome to CODE RED---an electrifying world where Parisian cabaret meets Amsterdam's edge, Moscow's mystique, and the unapologetic glamour of Studio 54. Fashion is as much a part of the performance as the artists themselves, with striking couture, bold silhouettes, and runway-worthy style setting the scene for an unforgettable night. Expect dazzling performances, intoxicating music, provocative artistry, and immersive moments that blur the line between audience and spectacle. Inspired by the golden age of nightlife, where icons, artists, and dreamers came to see and be seen, CODE RED celebrates fearless self-expression, decadent entertainment, and the thrill of the unexpected. Dress boldly. Stay curious. Bring your calling card. Welcome to the show where fantasy, fashion, and nightlife collide.

    TOUR ENTRANCE: Guests will enter through the Hard Rock Cafe adjacent to Gate 6 (corner of 161st St. and River Ave). This self-guided experience allows guests to explore the museum at their leisure. Knowledgeable tour guides will be on-hand to share stories about exhibit content and displayed memorabilia. Entry available 11:30 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. Schedule and availability may vary due to ballpark-wide events. IMPORTANT: Glimpse of Greatness does not offer any field visibility or interior views of Yankee Stadium. The Yankees reserve the right to cancel all or part of any tour.
